correctness.rationale: All eight derivation coefficients are allowed because the defining squares differentiate to zero. D^2=0 is equivalent to three explicitly derived polynomial equations. For v≠0 a unique parametrization by (v,u) gives q^2(q^2−1) points, and for v=0 nilpotent B and c in ker B give q^3+q^2−q. Explicit polynomial one-parameter degenerations prove every boundary point lies in the closure of the smooth 4-dimensional open stratum over an algebraic closure. Rank counts follow from the images of generators. Extractable verify.py exhaustively checks all 256 and 65536 derivations over fields of orders 2 and 4 by literal matrix multiplication and field Gaussian elimination.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The proposed statement is a complete rank-stratified count and geometric irreducibility result for square-zero derivations on a specific characteristic-two algebra. Prior rank-spectrum results on quadratic-jet algebras use a different quotient ideal and hypotheses, and Witt W_1 centralizer results are different size/prime. The p>2 full nilpotent variety theorems do not mathematically imply the p=2 restricted nilpotence assertion.

originality.rationale: Targeted restricted-nullcone, group-algebra, square-zero vector-field, and truncated Witt searches did not disclose coverage. Material from Premet 1992 and 2014 explicitly restricts characteristic to p>2, and addresses a broader nilpotent cone or regularity rather than this p=2 restricted-square-zero and rank-frequency problem. Own earlier derivation-count findings concern different rings or Lie algebras. No claim of certified priority; an unindexed specialized p=2 vector-field reference remains possible.
residual_risks: Searches do not exclude an unindexed prior article specializing to height-one restricted vector-field varieties in characteristic two.
The proof establishes the geometry only for the reduced underlying variety; it must not be misread as scheme-theoretic radicality or normality.
Published comparison snippets for distant results were not treated as substitutes for primary full-text examination.

value.rationale: The restricted square-zero locus is the first height-one multivariate instance of a natural nilpotence invariant in modular Witt derivation theory. The theorem simultaneously gives the irreducible rational geometry over all characteristic-two fields, an exact count over every finite extension, and the complete possible operator ranks and multiplicities. This is a canonical full classification of one minimal multivariate case, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice or small finite census; no general classification is claimed.
